chunks: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said: 'Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women.' But the unbelievers' stratagem is bound to fail.
ai.seo_question: What did the Banu Quraiza command their children to do regarding the Banu Najjar during the Battle of Khandaq?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Banu Qurayza's treachery during the Battle of the Trench, where they conspired with the Banu Najjar (or Banu Quraiza's own allies) to eliminate the Muslim community. The command to kill the sons and spare the women highlights a strategic attempt to preserve lineage while decimating the fighting force, illustrating the 'craftiness' (kidm) of the disbelievers which ultimately proves futile against divine truth.
